semiconductor_relevance: High — Ibaraki University, Semiconductor Laboratory is engaged in the research and development of semiconductor materials, specifically focusing on high-purity silicides for infrared sensors.
summary: Ibaraki University, Semiconductor Laboratory specializes in the development of semiconductor silicides and has created a unique high-purity MgSi infrared sensor. Their research includes advanced crystal growth techniques aimed at producing bulk crystals with nanoperiodic structures.
capabilities: Unique crystal growth technology for nanoperiodic structures
